_comment: ZeRO-3 for the FULL fine-tune arm of lab 7. The 'auto' values are a HuggingFace Trainer convention, not a DeepSpeed feature: Trainer substitutes its own TrainingArguments before DeepSpeed sees this file. Launch without Trainer and 'auto' is a parse error.
_why_zero3_here: Measured by verify_arch.py: full fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B needs 119.7 GB of weights + optimizer on one card and 15.0 GB across eight. LoRA on the same model needs 15.3 GB on ONE card, so the LoRA arm deliberately does not use this file -- sharding what already fits is decoration, and this course has twice measured that reaching for hardware before checking was wrong (lab 5: GPU 1.7x SLOWER; lab 6: GPU physics 1.50x against a 5x bar).
_stage3_init_trap: Under stage 3 this config must exist BEFORE from_pretrained, or zero.Init never fires and every rank materialises the whole model. The symptom is an OOM whose requested allocation is trivially small on a card with gigabytes spare. train_vlm.py builds TrainingArguments first for exactly this reason.
_activations_do_not_sharD: ZeRO-3 shards parameters, gradients and optimizer state. It does NOT shard activations, and for a VLM the image tokens dominate the sequence. Size per GPU, not in aggregate.
